data.one_liner: Live, on-device text recognition for Flutter using Apple Vision on iOS and ML Kit on Android.
data.what_it_does: Performs fast, on-device optical character recognition (OCR) via a live camera view or from static images. It integrates Apple Vision natively on iOS without adding third-party ML frameworks, while using ML Kit with an on-demand model download on Android.
use_when: You need real-time OCR or text scanning within a live Flutter camera preview.
You want to avoid bundling heavy third-party ML frameworks into your iOS application build.
You need to extract text from a single image file or byte array without using a camera.
avoid_when: You need to scan barcodes or QR codes instead of text.
You are targeting Android devices that do not support Latin script text recognition.
strengths: Uses native Apple Vision on iOS, keeping app builds lighter.
Unbundled Android ML Kit model by default to keep initial APK size small.
Provides normalized bounding boxes across both platforms so layout code does not branch on platform.
weaknesses: Android text recognition is currently restricted to Latin script only.
Live scanning requires a physical device because the iOS Simulator lacks a camera.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the NSCameraUsageDescription permission string to ios/Runner/Info.plist for iOS camera access.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick mobile_scanner if you need barcode and QR code scanning instead of text OCR.
